title: Nexus
lede: Workshops, fireside chats, and events for anyone curious about startups — no application, no semester-long commitment.

mission.heading: The On-Ramp to Everything Else
mission.body:
If you don't want to commit to a semester-long program but you're still curious about startups, or you want to expand your network, Nexus is where to start.

It's also where founders in Spark and Bolt come to network and get wider exposure.

items.label: Workshops & Panels
items.text: Hands-on sessions and fireside chats, open to everyone.

items.label: Networking Events
items.text: Meet other founders, students, and people already building.

items.label: Ideation Hackathon
items.text: Go from a blank page to an idea worth pursuing in a day.

items.label: Pitch Competition
items.text: Put an early idea in front of a room and see how it holds up.
